nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) private _rOwned; reflection-token internal balances used by _transferStandard, _takeTeam and balanceOf.
mapping(address => uint256) private _tOwned; declared token balances, never written in this contract.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances; ERC20 allowance table written by _approve and read by allowance/transferFrom.
mapping(address => bool) private _isExcludedFromFee; addresses exempt from tax and cooldown logic.
mapping(address => bool) private bots; blacklist enforced inside _transfer, mutated by setBots/delBot.
mapping(address => uint) private cooldown; per-address timestamp gate written with block.timestamp.
uint256 private _rTotal; total reflection supply, reduced inside _reflectFee.
uint256 private _tFeeTotal; cumulative reflection fee accounting.
uint256 private _feeAddr1; first fee rate consumed by _getValues/_getTValues.
uint256 private _feeAddr2; second fee rate consumed by _getValues/_getTValues.
address payable private _feeAddrWallet1; fee recipient and privileged caller for manualswap/manualsend.
address payable private _feeAddrWallet2; second fee recipient in sendETHToFee.
IUniswapV2Router02 private uniswapV2Router; router used for swaps and liquidity.
address private uniswapV2Pair; created pair, used to classify buys/sells in _transfer.
bool private tradingOpen; flag set by openTrading.
bool private inSwap; reentrancy-style guard managed by the lockTheSwap modifier.
bool private swapEnabled; gates automatic contract-token swaps inside _transfer.
bool private cooldownEnabled; gates the timestamp cooldown branch inside _transfer.
uint256 private _maxTxAmount; maximum transfer amount enforced inside _transfer.
address private _owner; authority checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender: external caller address used for ownership, transfers and privileged checks.
block.timestamp: used in the cooldown gate and as Uniswap deadlines.
tx.origin: not referenced in this contract, tracked as an untrusted origin channel.
constructor(): sets fee wallets, mints the entire reflection supply to the deployer and exempts addresses from fees.
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public override: forwards msg.sender into _transfer.
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public override: moves tokens and decrements allowance.
approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public override: delegates to _approve.
balanceOf(address account) public view: converts reflection balance to token balance.
allowance(address owner, address spender) public view: reads _allowances.
_transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) private: tax selection, blacklist, cooldown gate and automatic swap/send of collected ETH.
_approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) private: validates addresses and writes _allowances.
swapTokensForEth(uint256 tokenAmount) private lockTheSwap: approves the router and performs the swap with block.timestamp as deadline.
sendETHToFee(uint256 amount) private: splits the contract ETH balance between the two fee wallets.
openTrading() external onlyOwner: creates the pair, adds liquidity, enables swapping and cooldown.
setBots(address[] memory bots_) public onlyOwner: blacklists a list of addresses.
delBot(address notbot) public onlyOwner: removes an address from the blacklist.
setCooldownEnabled(bool onoff) external onlyOwner: toggles the timestamp cooldown feature.
manualswap() external: triggers a swap of the contract token balance, guarded only by a comparison with _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend() external: transfers the whole contract ETH balance to fee wallets, guarded only by a comparison with _feeAddrWallet1.
_tokenTransfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) private: delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard(...) private: computes values, mutates _rOwned balances, takes team fee and reflects fee.
_takeTeam(uint256 tTeam) private: converts team fee to reflection units and credits the contract.
_reflectFee(uint256 rFee, uint256 tFee) private: reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal.
_getValues(uint256 tAmount) private view: combines _getTValues, _getRate and _getRValues.
_getTValues(uint256 tAmount, uint256 taxFee, uint256 TeamFee) private pure: splits amount into fee, team and transfer portions.
_getRValues(...) private pure: scales token amounts by the current reflection rate.
_getRate() private view: divides reflection supply by token supply.
_getCurrentSupply() private view: returns reflection and token supply, comparing _rTotal against _rTotal/_tTotal.
tokenFromReflection(uint256 rAmount) private view: converts a reflection amount into a token amount.
receive() external payable: accepts ETH, e.g. router swap proceeds.
External call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with user-controlled tokenAmount and zero slippage protection.
Native ETH transfer to _feeAddrWallet1/_feeAddrWallet2 performed by sendETHToFee.
External payable call to uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH with amountMin and amountETHMin set to zero.
External call to IUniswapV2Factory.createPair whose returned address is trusted without verification.
Reflection supply arithmetic: _rTotal subtraction in _reflectFee and the division inside _getRate/_getCurrentSupply.
parameter from of _transfer; source address whose _rOwned balance is debited.
parameter to of _transfer; destination address checked against pair, router and cooldown.
parameter amount of _transfer; compared against _maxTxAmount and cooldown.
parameter recipient of transfer, forwarded to _transfer.
parameter amount of transfer, forwarded to _transfer.
parameter sender of transferFrom, debited by _transfer and by the allowance update.
parameter recipient of transferFrom.
parameter amount of transferFrom, subtracted from the allowance.
parameter spender of approve, forwarded to _approve.
parameter amount of approve, written into _allowances.
parameter bots_ array of setBots, each element written into the bots mapping.
parameter notbot of delBot, cleared in the bots mapping.
parameter onoff of setCooldownEnabled, assigned to cooldownEnabled.
parameter tokenAmount of swapTokensForEth, approved to the router and swapped.
local address[] path built inside swapTokensForEth as [token, WETH].
parameter amount of sendETHToFee, split in half between the two fee wallets.
local router instance created in openTrading from the hardcoded Uniswap V2 address.
local contractTokenBalance computed via balanceOf(address(this)) inside _transfer.
local contractETHBalance read from address(this).balance inside _transfer.
parameter account of balanceOf, used as key into _rOwned.
parameter owner of _approve, validated against the zero address.
parameter spender of _approve, validated against the zero address.
parameter amount of _approve, stored in _allowances.
parameter tAmount of _transferStandard, converted into reflection values.
parameter tAmount of _getTValues, multiplied by the tax rates.
parameter taxFee of _getTValues, sourced from _feeAddr1.
parameter TeamFee of _getTValues, sourced from _feeAddr2.

edges.reason: transfer forwards recipient and amount to _transfer.
transferFrom forwards sender, recipient and amount to _transfer.
msg.sender becomes the from argument of _transfer in transfer(), and the spender in transferFrom().
_transfer finishes by calling _tokenTransfer to apply the actual balance changes.
_tokenTransfer delegates the accounting to _transferStandard.
_transfer performs the external swapTokensForEth call before _tokenTransfer settles the sender and recipient balances.
swapTokensForEth hands control to the router before the balances are finalised, allowing reentrant flows through the token transfer hooks.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee which pushes ETH out to the fee wallets during transfer processing.
sendETHToFee performs native value transfers to _feeAddrWallet1 and _feeAddrWallet2.
block.timestamp is read inside _transfer for the cooldown comparison and update, making transfer eligibility time dependent.
cooldown[to] is written as block.timestamp + 30 seconds.
cooldown[to] is read in _transfer to decide whether the transfer is allowed.
bots[from] and bots[to] are read to revert blacklisted transfers; the blacklist is a privileged control channel.
cooldownEnabled gates the cooldown branch inside _transfer.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap and ETH distribution inside _transfer.
uniswapV2Router is used as the swap target inside swapTokensForEth.
uniswapV2Pair identifies buy versus sell direction for fee and cooldown logic.
_maxTxAmount caps the transfer amount inside the cooldown branch.
balanceOf(address(this)) is used to size the automatic swap.
balanceOf converts reflection balances via tokenFromReflection.
_transferStandard obtains all fee and amount values from _getValues.
_transferStandard credits the team fee through _takeTeam.
_transferStandard applies the reflection fee through _reflectFee.
_getValues calls _getTValues for token denominated splits.
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection denominated splits.
_getValues reads the current rate from _getRate.
_getRate derives the rate from _getCurrentSupply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal and divides it by _tTotal, the core reflection arithmetic surface.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal and adds tFee to _tFeeTotal.
_rTotal is mutated by the reflection arithmetic, making reflection supply accounting the arithmetic hotspot.
_feeAddr1 supplies the tax fee rate used by _getValues/_getTValues.
_feeAddr2 supplies the team fee rate used by _getValues/_getTValues.
_takeTeam adds rTeam to _rOwned[address(this)].
_transferStandard subtracts rAmount from the sender and adds rTransferAmount to the recipient in _rOwned.
constructor assigns _feeAddrWallet1.
constructor assigns _feeAddrWallet2.
constructor derives ownership and initial supply from _msgSender().
constructor mints the whole reflection supply into _rOwned of the deployer.
constructor seeds the _isExcludedFromFee allow-list that bypasses taxes and cooldown.
approve delegates to _approve.
transferFrom decreases the allowance through _approve.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender].
transferFrom subtracts the amount from _allowances[sender][msg.sender] before updating it.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH on the router, an external payable interaction.
openTrading calls factory().createPair, an external call whose result is stored unfiltered.
openTrading installs the router into uniswapV2Router.
openTrading installs the created pair into uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the Uniswap deadline, making liquidity operations miner-influenceable.
openTrading enables swapEnabled, arming the automatic swap path inside _transfer.
openTrading enables cooldownEnabled, arming the timestamp gate inside _transfer.
openTrading lowers _maxTxAmount from the total supply to a fixed cap.
openTrading is protected by onlyOwner which compares _owner against _msgSender().
setBots is protected by onlyOwner, guarding the blacklist mutation.
delBot is protected by onlyOwner, guarding the blacklist mutation.
setCooldownEnabled is protected by onlyOwner.
_transfer compares from/to against owner() to skip blacklist, cooldown and fee logic.
setBots writes true into the bots mapping for each supplied address.
delBot clears the bots mapping entry for the supplied address.
setCooldownEnabled assigns the caller-supplied flag to cooldownEnabled.
manualswap triggers a router swap using only a hardcoded wallet comparison as authorisation.
manualswap authorises the caller by comparing _msgSender() with _feeAddrWallet1 rather than using the owner role.
manualsend drains the contract ETH balance through sendETHToFee using only a hardcoded wallet comparison as authorisation.
manualsend authorises the caller by comparing _msgSender() with _feeAddrWallet1 rather than using the owner role.
inSwap, toggled by the lockTheSwap modifier, guards swapTokensForEth against nested swaps.
swapTokensForEth builds the swap path array locally.
_transfer reads its from parameter for balance debiting and blacklist checks.
_transfer reads its to parameter for pair detection and cooldown handling.
_transfer reads its amount parameter for _maxTxAmount enforcement.
transfer receives the recipient parameter and forwards it to _transfer.
transfer receives the amount parameter and forwards it to _transfer.
transferFrom forwards the sender parameter to _transfer.
transferFrom forwards the recipient parameter to _transfer.
transferFrom uses the amount parameter for the transfer and the allowance subtraction.
approve forwards the spender parameter to _approve.
approve forwards the amount parameter to _approve.
setBots iterates the bots_ parameter array and writes each entry.
delBot writes the notbot parameter into the bots mapping.
setCooldownEnabled assigns the onoff parameter to cooldownEnabled.
swapTokensForEth approves and swaps the tokenAmount parameter.
sendETHToFee splits the amount parameter between the two fee wallets.
openTrading instantiates a local router instance to configure the pair and liquidity.
the contractTokenBalance local is passed into swapTokensForEth.
the contractETHBalance local is passed into sendETHToFee.
balanceOf keys into _rOwned using the account parameter.
_approve uses the owner parameter for validation and the allowance key.
_approve uses the spender parameter for validation and the allowance key.
_approve stores the amount parameter into _allowances.
_transferStandard converts the tAmount parameter through _getValues.
_getTValues uses the tAmount parameter for the fee split.
_getTValues uses the taxFee parameter to compute the fee portion.
_getTValues uses the TeamFee parameter to compute the team portion.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to source and validate the sender inside _transfer.
The to parameter only drives pair detection, cooldown and blacklist checks inside _transfer.
The amount parameter is only consumed by the _maxTxAmount check and the balance accounting of _transfer.
The recipient parameter is a straight-through argument of transfer.
The amount parameter is a straight-through argument of transfer.
The sender parameter is only used by transferFrom to call _transfer and update the allowance.
The recipient parameter is only forwarded by transferFrom.
The amount parameter is only used by transferFrom for the transfer and allowance subtraction.
The spender parameter is forwarded directly from approve to _approve.
The amount parameter is forwarded directly from approve to _approve.
The bots_ array parameter is only iterated by setBots when writing the blacklist.
The notbot parameter is only written into the bots mapping by delBot.
The onoff parameter is only assigned to cooldownEnabled by setCooldownEnabled.
The tokenAmount parameter is the input size of the unchecked router swap, so it collapses into the swap operation.
The locally built path array exists only to parameterise the router swap call.
The amount parameter is the value pushed out by the native transfers in sendETHToFee.
The local router instance is only a temporary handle configured and stored by openTrading.
The contractTokenBalance local is computed solely to be passed into swapTokensForEth.
The contractETHBalance local is read solely to be passed into sendETHToFee.
The account parameter is only used by balanceOf as a key into _rOwned.
The owner parameter is only validated and used as an allowance key inside _approve.
The spender parameter is only validated and used as an allowance key inside _approve.
The amount parameter is only stored into _allowances by _approve.
The tAmount parameter is only converted into reflection values by _transferStandard.
The tAmount parameter is only split into fee components by _getTValues.
The taxFee parameter is only a rate input to the fee split in _getTValues.
The TeamFee parameter is only a rate input to the team split in _getTValues.
